_doc: Placeholder. Run `scripts/capture_reasoning_usage_fixture.py <model_id> <provider_tag>` with a live OPENROUTER_API_KEY to overwrite this with a REAL usage payload. Both args are required. Billing is per ENDPOINT, not per model or per provider name: GET /api/v1/models/{author}/{slug}/endpoints (public, no key) shows e.g. tags 'azure' and 'azure/swedencentral' both under provider_name 'Azure' with different completion rates. So the capture resolves the endpoint whose `tag` EXACTLY equals the pin (failing on a missing or ambiguous tag), prices only from that endpoint, and verifies the router's selected display name against that endpoint's provider_name -- which accepts a variant tag while still rejecting a different provider. A capture that cannot verify its route fails and leaves this file untouched. The gate re-derives the verdict from the stored price_authority (USD per token, with source + fetched_at); registry differences are reported as drift, never a reclassification. While _placeholder is true the live gate skips; the endpoint-pricing, routing-metadata and synthetic-case tests run regardless.
